name: Kokoro no Doki Doki Senpai??: Milky Pantsu Adventure
source:
KnDDS:MPA, or simply Kokoro, revolves around the player, aptly named “Player-kun” on his journey to acquire pantsu and love during his third year at Sakura Blossom Academy. Along the way he will befriend other students at the school and deal with his angry and overbearing teacher, Sensei-sensei.

Will Player-kun find true love and/or pantsu? That’s for YOU to decide!
translation:
《心跳心跳学长？：奶裤冒险》简称KnDDS:MPA，或直接称作《心跳》。玩家将扮演“玩家君”，在樱花绽放学院度过高中三年级生活，一边收集内裤，一边寻找爱情。途中，你会与学校里的其他学生成为朋友，还要应付脾气暴躁又专横的老师老师。

玩家君能找到真爱和（或）内裤吗？答案由你决定！
